login.title: Bulls and Cows
login.subtitle: A logic game for the whole family
login.welcomeText: A logic game for the whole family. Guess the number, herd the bulls into the barn and lift the fog.
login.name: Player name
login.resetSent: If that email exists, we sent a reset link.

validation.passwordShort: The password must be at least 6 characters

reset.title: New password
reset.text: Choose a new password for your profile. Then you go straight to the pasture.
reset.noLink: Open the link from the password reset email. If it has expired, request a new one from the sign-in screen.
reset.unavailable: Password reset by email is not available in the test environment. Sign in with a name and password or as a guest.

validation.short: The password must be at least 6 characters

error.same: The new password must differ from the old one.
error.weak: That password is too easy — pick a stronger one.
error.expired: The link has expired or was already used. Request a new one from the sign-in screen.
error.failed: We could not change the password. Try again.

step1.title: A number is hidden
step1.text: {{count}} different digits, the first one is not 0. Guess it in as few tries as you can.

step2.title: Bulls and cows
step2.bullDesc: a right digit in the right place. It runs home to the barn.
step2.cowDesc: the digit is in the number, but in another place. It grazes outside.

fog.title: The fog and the notebook
fog.text: The fog over the pasture lifts as the possibilities shrink. Use the notebook to mark which digits are out and which are certain.
fog.textLong: With every guess the possible numbers shrink and the fog over the pasture lifts. In the notebook you mark which digits are out and which are certain, and jot down notes. Points grow with fewer guesses and a faster time.

newGame.title: New game

race.name: Race
race.desc: One number for both. First to guess it wins.

classic.name: Classic
classic.desc: Each hides their own number. You take turns.

quick.name: Quick match
quick.desc: A random player of a similar level.

friend.name: Invite a friend
friend.desc: With a code or a link.

newGame.quickNote: Quick match pairs you only with real people of a similar level.

play.keyboardHint: You can also type: digits, Backspace, Enter.

play.practiceNote: Today's number is already played — this game is just for practice.
play.offlineBanner: You're offline. Your guesses are kept and sent once you're back.

board.caption: Today's herd

board.guestOnly: The leaderboard is for registered shepherds.

invite.title: Invite a friend
invite.text: Send the code or the link. The duel starts as soon as your friend joins.

invite.qrAlt: QR code with the duel link

scan.button: Scan the QR code with the camera

queue.title: Finding an opponent
queue.widening: We widen the search every 5 seconds. Real players only.
queue.noMatch: No suitable opponent yet. You can keep waiting or invite a friend.

rule.race: Race: the same number for both. First to guess it wins.
rule.classic: Classic: each hides their own number and you take turns. Equal number of moves — a draw.

found.clockNote: The clock starts once you're both ready.

easy.name: Easy
easy.desc: The Scarecrow dozes off and sometimes slips — for little kids and first games.

normal.name: Medium
normal.desc: Pays attention and only tries numbers that fit the hints.

hard.name: Hard
hard.desc: Thinks like an old shepherd — picks guesses that narrow things down the most.

expert.name: Expert
expert.desc: Never slips and plays fast. For masters only.

noWaste.name: No wasted move
noWaste.desc: A win without a single illogical guess

sherlock.name: Sherlock
sherlock.desc: A 4-digit number solved in 4 guesses or fewer

allCows.name: All cows
allCows.desc: A guess with every digit right, all in the wrong place

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.desc: Solved on the first or second guess

streak.name: Streak
streak.desc: Days in a row with the number of the day solved

early.name: Early bird
early.desc: The number of the day before 8:00

night.name: Night shift
night.desc: The number of the day after 22:00

month.name: Whole month
month.desc: Every day of a calendar month

formats.name: All formats

notes.desc: Games where you used the notebook

invite.name: Brought a friend

hidden.desc: A hidden badge — find it yourself
